(bucladesine) Profile Bucladesine sodium has been reported to have cardiotonic prop- erties when given intravenously. It has been applied topically for the treatment of bedsores. Bufotenine Bufotenin; Bufotenina; NN-Dimethylserotonin; 5-Hydroxy-NN- dimethyltryptamine; Mappine. 3-(2-Dimethylaminoethyl)indol-5- ol. Буфотенин C12H16N2O = 204.3. CAS — 487-93-4. Profile Bufotenine is an indole alkaloid obtained from the seeds and leaves of Piptadenia peregrina, from which the hallucinogenic snuff cohoba is prepared, and P. macrocarpa (Mimosaceae). It was first isolated from the skin glands of toads (Bufo spp.) and has also been isolated from species of Amanita (Agaricaceae). Bufotenine has serotonergic activity and is reported to have hal- lucinogenic properties. It has no therapeutic use.
